name: Melissa Brideman
source: The protagonist. She is innocent, pure-hearted, and hopeful to a fault. She is far too trusting, honest, and vulnerable, wearing her heart on her sleeve, and easily discouraged. Because of this, she is often bullied, and accidentally gets mixed up into trouble. She only wants to make friends at her new school, but ends up getting embroiled with the three most popular students instead. Bride.
